text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last, the Mile Ch. is here! Hishi Akebono has built up her physique and is in perfect form for her rematch against Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her unusually strong desire to win has the stands riveted. Cheers for Hishi Akebono rain down from every direction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Taiki Shuttle's fans are out in full force as well! They're positive Taiki Shuttle is guaranteed to win, and they're behind her 100%.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The racecourse is electric. The curtain rises on the epic, pulse-pounding clash!
